why: Skeletal Mage (display of a robed skeleton caster): the stock creature that bears the name of the skill's summon; the module gives it its AI and no loot
Skeletal Warrior (display of an armed skeleton): the skeletal minion Command Skeletons raises; the module gives it its AI and no loot
Flesh Golem (a stitched corpse golem, the name of the skill's own minion and of its Flesh Golem rune): the Golem Command Golem raises; the module gives it its AI and no loot
Skeleton (a plain skeletal body): the body a revived corpse is given; the module puts the corpse's own look on it when it is raised, and gives it its AI and no loot
the stock Mage Mirror Image creature (the Wizard's Mirror Image donor): the module copies the Necromancer's look onto it, as the Wizard's images copy the Wizard, and gives it its AI and no loot
